scopeNotes: All 12 current owner/co-owner claims were checked, including T2/T3 claims below the application tracker threshold.
The 239 claim containers are shared public claim storage, including returned storehouse interiors. Items there would show association, not personal ownership.
The personal inventory page includes bank pockets in other towns and the populated residential-house containers. The separate housing endpoint also checks the empty container.
Providers overlap. Their inventories and the house were not added together as unique physical tools.
Former island regions 3, 11, 15 and 23 are excluded from current inventory totals.

The sources disagree on record coverage and return some stale/nameless memberships. Only 12 named current owner/co-owner claims verified by Bitjita claim detail and BitSync inventory endpoints are in the main scope.

Storage history searches used the public page data endpoint; similarly named API query parameters were found not to apply these filters. Every retained result was checked against the exact subject player ID.
limitations: Zero found is not a complete lifetime possession count. There is no complete item custody ledger in these public responses.
The original page displayed 500 trades. A follow-up API inspection paginated all 678 reported trades; see logging-evidence.json.
Rare-craft history is the source-described 30-day feed, not lifetime crafting history.
Current claim relationships do not reconstruct every former claim membership or off-claim/personal trade.
Deposits and withdrawals are movements. The same physical tool can appear repeatedly; they are not distinct-item counts.
No ownership or alternate-account identity is inferred from another player sharing a claim.
